tools.name: spritefusion-pixel-snapper
constraints: Use positional color count32 before the fixed palette; default16 would discard detail first.
Pixel-size override does not guarantee exact output dimensions or aspect ratio.
Do not overwrite calibrated map geometry or source art with elastic output.

tools.name: spritefusion-sprite-normals
constraints: Does not align pixel grids or change the source palette.
Generate normals after final color/alpha/grid acceptance, frame by frame.
Normal maps are linear data; preserve frame layout and alpha. Do not map them to the art palette.
